verdict.rationale: GitHub's docs mention updating vulnerable dependencies with supported fixes and running security campaigns to reduce vulnerabilities (github-docs-6, github-docs-14), which aligns with Dependabot-style automated dependency update PRs, but the evidence never explicitly names Dependabot or describes the automatic pull-request workflow in detail. Missing for 10: explicit description of automatic PR creation/scheduling, naming of the Dependabot feature, and independent/hands-on corroboration of it working as claimed.
